description: Schema v1 of the flow stream.

active_s.description: S702 Implementer turn time on the unit in the history window (flow efficiency: active) (unit: s)

aged_units.description: S702 units idle longer than their age expectation

already_closed.description: S702 the pull request was closed before the close ran

author_class.description: S702 author of the pull request: OWNER, AGENT, OTHER, UNKNOWN

authority.description: S702 who decides a close: OWNER (disposition) or PILOT (agent-authored with a Work Item)

blocker.description: S702 first typed blocker: HOLD:<predicate>, DISPOSITION:<status>, REMEDY:<remedy>, CUSTODY:<state>:<reason>, GATE:<criteria>, NONE

class_reason.description: S702 why the operation has its class (NEW_WORK_ITEM_PULL_REQUEST, UNSTARTED_WORK_ITEM, ...)

closed.description: S702 the typed close read back closed

closeness.description: S702 closeness to merge 0..1 (the scheduler aging term)

condition.description: S702 the condition a transition entered or left (or LEFT_WIP)

custody_state.description: S702 goal custody state:reason of the unit's Work Item

deadline_ts.description: S702 the convergence deadline the pilot set (CONVERGE_ROUTE)

derived.description: computed from other records; replaced on recomputation

disposition_status.description: S702 status of the unit's S694 disposition review

entered.description: S702 the condition was entered (false: left)

entity.description: key of a mutable entity: keep the latest version (by ts, then record_id)

expectation_s.description: S702 the age expectation of the unit class without real progress (unit: s)

failing_criteria.description: S702 merge-admission criteria failing at the latest verdict

hold_expired_units.description: S702 units held longer than the hold expiry

hold_predicate.description: S702 the S685 hold predicate or OWNER_HOLD

implementer_tokens.description: S702 Implementer tokens on the unit in the history window (unit: tokens)

implementer_turns.description: S702 launched Implementer turns on the unit in the history window

last_progress_ts.description: S702 time of the last real progress

link_status.description: S702 the Work Item link of the close (PRESENT, POSTED, UNCONFIRMED, FAILED)

over_limit.description: S702 open pull requests above the limit

progress_kind.description: S702 the last real progress: CRITERION_GREEN, VERDICT_ALLOW, THREADS_DOWN, DECIDED, MERGED, OPENED, NONE_OBSERVED

reason.description: typed reason (class of the source reason)

record_id.description: stable id: sha256 of the source pointer and the normalized content, or of an explicit identity for observations, snapshots and derived rows

stage_counts.description: S702 units per stage (STARTED, CONVERGING, MERGEABLE, MERGED, CLOSED)

started_ts.description: S702 start of the unit (the pull request created_at; a Work Item: its first launched turn)

trend.description: S702 CONVERGING, DIVERGING, FLAT or UNKNOWN over the trend window

trend_counts.description: S702 pull request units per trend (CONVERGING, DIVERGING, FLAT, UNKNOWN)

ts.description: UTC time of the fact; the partition day

ts_basis.description: set when ts is not the record time itself

tune_metrics.description: S702 the expectations the data supports (p85 cycle time of merged pull requests)

unit_age_s.description: S702 work item age: now minus the start (unit: s)

unit_class.description: S702 OWNER_PR, AGENT_PR, OTHER_PR or WORK_ITEM (the age expectation class)

unit_idle_s.description: S702 time since the last real progress (or the start) (unit: s)

unit_remedy.description: S702 the registered remedy of the unit's Work Item

unit_stage.description: S702 STARTED, CONVERGING (a DENY verdict), MERGEABLE (ALLOW at the head), MERGED, CLOSED

units.description: unit of every field of the record that has one

unresolved_threads.description: S702 unresolved review threads at the latest exact read

verdict.description: S702 latest merge-admission verdict status (ALLOW, DENY)

verdict_current.description: S702 the verdict is at the open head

window_days.description: window of the scorecard (QUOTA_WEIGHT: of the readings and turns the estimate used; FLOW_DAILY: of the flow metrics) (unit: days)

wip.description: S702 open pull requests (the WIP the start limit counts)

wip_basis.description: S702 where the open set came from: OBSERVER_SCOPE (complete) or PORTFOLIO (last reads)

wip_limit.description: S702 the limit for starting new work (supervision.wip.limit_open_prs)

work_items_started.description: S702 Work Items started (an open pull request or a launched Implementer turn)

title: flow
